# A1 step 3 — the token vocabulary

**Date:** 2026-08-08
**Status:** Draft — the reviewed artifact Child B's mapping table targets.
**Source:** `app/utils/__tests__/__fixtures__/colour-inventory.json`, generated by
`node scripts/colour-inventory.mjs`.

**Every figure here is generated. Where this document and the inventory disagree, the
inventory wins** — and every RGB triplet below was verified against its hex programmatically.

This completes A1 step 3, which an earlier pass left at *acceptance criteria for a
vocabulary* rather than a vocabulary. Child B cannot be specified against tokens that do not
exist, so this had to land first.

---

## Storage convention — stated once, because getting it backwards is silent

**Base roles store a bare RGB triplet under a `-rgb` suffix**, consumed through Tailwind as
`rgb(var(--x-rgb) / <alpha-value>)`.

```css
--accent-rgb: 0 191 255;        /* the token */
```
```ts
accent: "rgb(var(--accent-rgb) / <alpha-value>)",   // tailwind.config.ts
```

`brand.css` already stores triplets (`--brand-frost: 215 231 246`) but **without** the
suffix. The suffix is new and it is load-bearing: it makes "this holds a triplet, not a
colour" visible at every use site.

**Consequences an implementer must not get backwards:**

- `rgb(var(--accent-rgb) / 0.2)` is valid. `rgb(var(--accent))` would be `rgb(rgb(…))` — not
  a valid `<color>`, silently dropped at computed-value time.
- The typography mapping is therefore **`--tw-prose-body: rgb(var(--ink-rgb))`**, *not*
  `var(--ink)`. v23 prescribed the inverse, which renders song lyrics unstyled with no build
  or lint signal.

**Naming rule, binding:** a token key may never begin with a utility prefix. `border-accent`
compiles to `.border-border-accent`, while `.border-accent` silently resolves to the base
`accent` role. Every key below is a bare role name for this reason.

---

## Layer 1 — base roles

**18 roles**, derived from the 20 distinct hex values carrying 1,264 bracketed sites, plus
the seven retired `--brand-*` colour variables. Counts are inventory rows.

**Two are named here rather than left as unnamed "· deep" entries in the state tables
below**, because they carry 6 rows between them and a mapping table cannot target a
description: `--warning-surface-deep-rgb: 28 8 0` (`#1c0800`, 3) and
`--info-surface-deep-rgb: 30 10 60` (`#1e0a3c`, 3).

### Accent

| Token | Triplet | From | Rows |
|---|---|---|---:|
| `--accent-rgb` | `0 191 255` | `#00bfff` | **806** |
| `--accent-deep-rgb` | `0 53 114` | `#003572` | **243** |

`#00bfff` is the accent (parent D6); `--brand-beam` `#12C8F4` is retired onto it. Together
these two are **83%** of the bracketed-hex surface.

**`--accent-deep` is deliberately not called `surface-navy`.** `#003572` serves two roles —
a light-side accent in most of its 243 sites, and a dark-native navy surface where it appears
with no `dark:` sibling. One name for both is honest here because the *value* is identical;
what differs is the pairing, which the composed layer expresses (Layer 2).

### Ink

| Token | Triplet | From | Rows |
|---|---|---|---:|
| `--ink-rgb` | `215 231 246` | `--brand-frost` | 39 utilities |
| `--ink-muted-rgb` | `200 216 235` | `#c8d8eb` | **78** |
| `--ink-dim-rgb` | `127 148 168` | `--brand-steel` | 61 utilities |

Three tiers, not two: `#c8d8eb` and `--brand-frost` are different values both used as
foreground, and collapsing them would change 78 sites.

### Surfaces

| Token | Triplet | From | Rows |
|---|---|---|---:|
| `--surface-base-rgb` | `1 11 23` | `#010b17` / `--brand-blackout` | 29 + 10 |
| `--surface-raised-rgb` | `13 34 52` | `--brand-deck` | 3 |
| `--surface-raised-alt-rgb` | `10 25 41` | `#0a1929` | 18 |
| `--surface-console-rgb` | `7 22 36` | `--brand-console` | 1 |
| `--surface-sunken-rgb` | `0 31 63` | `#001f3f` | 7 |

**A deliberate collapse, recorded with its count.** Five further near-identical navies
collapse onto `--surface-sunken`, **14 rows**: `#001830` (6, all in `MonthGenerator` and
`SetlistEditor`), `#002249` (**3**), `#00162e` (2), `#020f1c` (2), `#03101f` (1). They sit
within a few units of each other per channel and no design intent distinguishes them.

**One of the 14 is not a class.** `icons.tsx` carries `fill="#002249"` — a category-8 SVG
presentation attribute, not a utility. An earlier revision of this line prescribed
`currentColor` **or `rgb(var(--surface-sunken-rgb))`**. **The second option is wrong and Child
B's plan corrects it:** `var()` is not substituted inside SVG presentation attributes, so that
form is silently dropped. `currentColor` is also unavailable here, because `MoonIcon` carries
two different fills on sibling paths of one SVG. The working mechanisms are Tailwind's
`fill-*`/`stroke-*` utilities — which emit real CSS properties — or deletion of the file,
which is what B chose: `icons.tsx` has no importers. An earlier revision counted only
category-1 rows and reported 13; the collapse is 14, and Child B's diff list enumerates all
of them.

### Semantic states — three slots each

`DayCard.tsx:37–50` is the worked example: three literals for one state, per theme.

| State | Foreground | Surface | Border |
|---|---|---|---|
| **warning** | `--warning-fg-rgb: 245 158 11` (`#f59e0b`, 14) | `--warning-surface-rgb: 120 53 15` (`#78350f`, 7) · deep `28 8 0` (`#1c0800`, 3) | `--warning-border-rgb: 146 64 14` (`#92400e`, 2) |
| **info** | `--info-fg-rgb: 167 139 250` (`#a78bfa`, 30) | `--info-surface-rgb: 76 29 149` (`#4c1d95`, 7) · deep `30 10 60` (`#1e0a3c`, 3) | `--info-border-rgb: 91 33 182` (`#5b21b6`, 2) |
| **positive** | `--positive-fg-rgb: 55 245 138` (`--brand-signal`, 14 rows) | — | — |
| **negative** | `--negative-fg-rgb: 248 113 113` (`#f87171`, 1) | — | — |

`positive` and `negative` have foreground only **today**. Child C's `red` family (192 rows, 9
shades) and `green` (47 rows) will need surface and border slots — **that is C's decision,
made against its own per-family diff list, not pre-empted here.**

### Retired `--brand-*` mapping

| Retired | → | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `--brand-blackout` | `--surface-base` | identical value |
| `--brand-console` | `--surface-console` | |
| `--brand-deck` | `--surface-raised` | |
| `--brand-beam` `18 200 244` | `--accent` `0 191 255` | **A real value change** — parent D6. The only §3.3-style normalisation in Layer 1, and it repaints the atmosphere |
| `--brand-signal` `55 245 138` | `--positive-fg` `55 245 138` | identical value — the role takes signal's value, not `#3dff7c`'s |
| `--brand-frost` | `--ink` | identical value |
| `--brand-steel` | `--ink-dim` | identical value |

**Five of seven are value-identical renames. TWO change colour**, and both are licensed
normalisations Child B must enumerate:

1. **`--brand-beam` `18 200 244` → `--accent` `0 191 255`** — parent D6. **32** `brand.css`
   occurrences (29 alpha-bearing plus three alpha-free at `:120`, `:182`, `:219`) and 87
   utility usages, including `.brand-atmosphere`'s wash and `selection:bg-brand-beam/35` on
   both root layouts.
2. **`#3dff7c` `61 255 124` → `--positive-fg` `55 245 138`** — **6 rows**, all in
   `DayCard.tsx`: two bracketed `[#3dff7c]` and four `rgba(61,255,124,·)` at .10/.3/.5/.8.
   Two greens exist: `--brand-signal` `#37f58a` on **14** rows and `#3dff7c` on 6. The role
   takes signal's value because it carries more than twice the usage, so the six `#3dff7c`
   rows change. An earlier revision of this document claimed `--brand-signal` mapped onto
   `#3dff7c` and called the pair value-identical — **it is not**, and building to that claim
   would have made the equality harness fail on 14 rows or silently collapse two distinct
   greens.

Every other diff is a defect.

**Non-colour `--brand-*` are untouched:** `--brand-radius-panel`, `--brand-radius-control`,
`--brand-duration-fast`, `--brand-duration-reveal`. They are outside the codemod, outside the
lint rule, and outside the theme-parity guard's colour scope.

## Layer 2 — composed tokens, alpha baked per theme

**This layer exists because 166 of 246 per-element light/dark pairs differ in ALPHA, not
only in colour.** A theme-invariant opacity modifier cannot express it: `bg-accent/20` is 20%
in *both* themes, but the app needs opaque navy in light and 20% cyan in dark.

Generated: **24 distinct (light → dark) alpha-differing combinations** cover those 166 sites.
The top seven cover **136 of 166 (82%)**.

| Token | Light | Dark | Sites |
|---|---|---|---:|
| `--surface-accent-solid` | `accent-deep` @100% | `accent` @20% | **36** |
| `--surface-accent-30` | `accent-deep` @30% | `accent` @20% | **28** |
| `--surface-accent-hover` | `accent-deep` @80% | `accent` @30% | **24** |
| `--border-accent-subtle`¹ | `accent-deep` @15% | `accent` @10% | **20** |
| `--surface-accent-20` | `accent-deep` @20% | `accent` @15% | **13** |
| `--surface-accent-faint` | `accent-deep` @20% | `accent` @10% | **8** |
| `--surface-accent-wash` | `accent-deep` @10% | `accent` @5% | **7** |
| *17 further combinations* | | | **30** |

¹ **Naming caution:** `--border-accent-subtle` is a CSS custom property, not a Tailwind key.
The naming rule bans *token keys* starting with a utility prefix; a custom property may
describe its role freely. The Tailwind key it feeds must not be `border-…`.

**The 17-combination tail is the real judgement call.** Each appears 1–3 times. Child B must
either give each its own token, or collapse it onto a neighbour **and enumerate the collapse
with its site count in the per-file diff list** — the same standard Child C is held to.
Collapsing silently is what this whole apparatus exists to prevent.

**A composed token is opaque at the use site.** `bg-surface-accent-solid` carries its own
alpha; applying `/20` on top is a bug. Child B's lint rule bans opacity modifiers on Layer-2
keys.

## Literals in Child B's set with NO role here

The roles above cover the **category-1 bracketed hex** surface. Child B's disposition also
carries rows these roles do not describe, and B must decide each explicitly rather than
discover it mid-codemod:

| Rows | What | Whose call |
|---:|---|---|
| **6** | `ParticipationSidebar.tsx:6` — a **categorical** map: `#1D9E75 #378ADD #7F77DD #888780 #BA7517 #D9534F`, one row each. Six hues chosen to be distinguishable from one another, not to express a semantic state | **B**, and a semantic role set is the wrong shape. Either a `--chart-1…6` scale, or record it exempt as a data-encoding palette. *(The file's other 13 B rows are ordinary accent/ink literals the roles above do cover.)* |
| **4** | `ServiceReadinessCard.tsx:716–736` — `rgba(239,68,68,·)` at .10/.18/.45/.7, i.e. `red-500` | **C's family.** B must not pre-empt it |
| **4** | `DayCard.tsx` — `rgba(251,191,36,·)` at .10/.35/.6/.65, i.e. `amber-400` | **C's family**, same |
| **4** | `DayCard.tsx` — `rgba(61,255,124,·)` at .10/.3/.5/.8, i.e. the second green `#3dff7c` | **B** — these follow the `#3dff7c` → `--positive-fg` normalisation above, so they are part of licensed diff 2 and must be enumerated with it |
| **7** | `rgb(0 0 0 / α)` shadows in `brand.css` (six rows), plus `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)` at `tailwind.config.ts:38` (one row) | **B** — an `--elevation` role, or recorded as intentionally literal. Note `tailwind.config.ts:38` is outside the `app/**` glob and reachable only as a named out-of-glob input |
| **4** | `stroke="white"` ×2 (`AdminPanel.tsx:135`, `ProfilePanel.tsx:50`) and `fill="white"` ×2 (`icons.tsx:112`, `:157`) — SVG presentation attributes | **B**, corrected. An earlier revision of this row said C, but **all four rows are dispositioned `B` in the inventory**, which is the authority. The two in `icons.tsx` go with that file when B deletes it; the two live ones take a `stroke-*` utility on the appropriate role — **not** `rgb(var(…))` in the attribute, which is silently dropped |

**"The mapping table is the inventory" is true of dispositions, not of tokens.** The
inventory says *which child owns a row*; this document says *what a row becomes*, and for the
**29 rows** above it currently says nothing.

## What this vocabulary does NOT decide

- **Light values.** Every triplet above is the **dark** value. `.light` counterparts are
  Child D's, and A5 already establishes `#00bfff` cannot be reused as a light foreground:
  measured **2.12:1** on white, which fails AA.
- **Palette families.** `gray` (475), `red` (192), `amber` (91), `yellow` (50), `green` (47),
  `orange` (23), `purple` (14), `blue` (9) — 36 distinct (family, shade) pairs against these
  roles. **Child C's**, per family, with its own diff list. `yellow`/`orange`/`amber` versus a
  single `warning-*` is explicitly unresolved.
- **`white`/`black`.** Child C, staged last.

## Acceptance — checked against A1 step 3's criteria

| Criterion | Met |
|---|---|
| Every (family, shade) pair represented, or each collapse recorded with its site count | **Deferred to Child C by design**; the 5-navy collapse (14 rows, one of them an SVG attribute) and the 17-combination tail are recorded here |
| Three slots — fg, surface, border — for every state needing them | `warning` and `info` have all three; `positive`/`negative` have fg only today, and C decides the rest |
| Composed, alpha-baked tokens for alpha-differing pairs | 24 combinations, 166 sites, generated |
| Naming rule: no key begins with a utility prefix | Every Layer-1 key is a bare role name; the Layer-2 caution is noted above |
| Storage convention stated once | Triplet + `-rgb` suffix, with the prose-mapping consequence spelled out |
